Access

Independent researchers

Quick readMore contextTechnical detail

Who has useful work but cannot reach the people, infrastructure, or support needed to advance it?

My example

Good work starts in places without a grants office: a home lab, an open-source project, a small nonprofit. Being eligible for a program is not the same as having a usable path into it.

Question for the room. Who owns the first handoff when someone has promising work but no institution behind them?

A practical next step

Pilot a supported referral path for independent researchers and small teams. Record where the handoff breaks down.

Progress would mean: Time to a useful connection; completed handoffs; reasons people are turned away.

Agenda connection: Resource Guide, p. 14. Suggested breakout: Track C · Innovation infrastructure. Track placement and proposals are my contributions; the handouts provide the discussion context.

Participant proposals for the Widener-led, NSF-funded convening. Project examples include documented results, work in development, and proposed pilots.
